title: QB64-PE Debug Configuration
description: Launch configuration for the QB64-PE (vwatch) debugger.

program.description: Absolute path of the .bas program to compile (with $DEBUG) and debug.

compilerPath.description: Absolute path of the QB64PE compiler executable, e.g. /path/to/QB64pe/qb64pe.

port.description: TCP port the debugger hosts on (the debuggee connects back to it). Defaults to 9000.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop on the program's first executable line.

autoAddDebug.description: Append $DEBUG to a temporary copy if the source lacks it.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the debuggee to connect back.
